reuse.why: The new Fintegra link goes through the existing linkAccountAndSync and findOrCreateBank, the provider is added to SYNC_PROVIDERS and syncAccount's dispatch, and unlinkAccount's reset is extracted into clearAccountLink and reused for take-over.

duplication.why: The guard call with its provider literal is repeated in all six link functions rather than once in the shared linkAccountAndSync, and downloadFintegraTransactions is another copy of the per-provider download template in sync.ts.

placement.why: Link rules sit in accounts/app.ts, but they are invoked from each provider wrapper instead of the shared link path, and a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked also enforces the closed-account rule and mutates another account.

scope.why: Every change serves one of the four steps (guard, Fintegra provider, closed check, take-over) plus tests.

maintainability.why: A future provider must remember to call the guard before findOrCreateBank, and the guard's name hides that it can clear another account's link, so its side effects are not obvious from call sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is routed around; linkAccountAndSync is still used by every provider, the guard is just called beside it instead of inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra download copy follows the existing per-provider pattern openly; the guard calls are plain repeated calls.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts grows a replaceExistingLink flag, a closed-account branch and a take-over branch that calls clearAccountLink, so the 'assert not linked' helper now also validates closed state and mutates other accounts; all six link functions call it.
